component.name: VesperTV
component.summary: Live TV with a guide, movies and shows from your own playlists

description.p: VesperTV plays your own IPTV playlists (M3U and Xtream Codes) with a TV guide, and movies and shows from your Media Hub add-ons or your Jellyfin, Emby or Plex server. It ships no content, has no ads and no tracking.

ul.li: Live TV with a timeline guide
Sports Trak: live scores matched to your channels
